question: What is the meaning of masses of materials used in buildings in relation to material information?
data_point: masses of materials used in buildings
description: The masses of materials used in buildings are crucial for understanding the environmental impacts and resource efficiency of the construction process. The increasing complexity of building materials and products makes it challenging to track and manage material information effectively. This lack of information leads to inefficiencies in material reuse and recycling, contributing to the large proportion of materials ending up in landfills or being downcycled. Therefore, standardised methods of data collection for materials and products within buildings are essential for promoting a circular economy and reducing the environmental footprint of the building sector. The materials passport concept aims to address this information gap by providing a digital tool to evaluate sustainability and communicate the performance of building materials and products. This tool can help identify opportunities for material reuse and recycling, optimize resource extraction, and increase the overall sustainability of the built environment.
